text: This S1000D data module documents a title page for front matter content. It is issue 8, dated December 31, 2016, classified as new and unverified. # Document Summary

This S1000D document is a highlights summary for Issue 4.2 of the S1000D specification, documenting changes approved by Change Proposal Forms (CPFs) and White Papers. It details modifications across all chapters including deleted chapters, business rule decision points updates (23 new, 136 deleted, 128 reworded), and extensive editorial changes to comply with new authoring rules and templates. The document provides chapter-by-chapter summaries referencing specific tables for detailed change information.

# Document Description

This S1000D specification chapter (1.3, Issue 008, December 2016) explains how to use the S1000D international standard for technical publications and training information. It provides an overview of the specification's structure and content, describes its field of application across platforms and systems, defines key terms (product, project, technical publications, learning information, data modules), and details two fundamental production/delivery approaches: self-contained versus Common Information Repository (CIR)-dependent data modules. It also explains the main delivery methods: data exchange between organizations and delivery of finished publications or training content packages.
